explanation.description: Explanation of why this integration was generated.

integrationVersion.description: The integration version containing basic triggers and tasks.

errorMsg.description: Add the error message when loops fail.

currentIterationDetail.description: Needs to be set by the loop impl class before each iteration. The abstract loop class will append the request and response to it. Eg. The foreach Loop will clean up and set it as the current iteration element at the start of each loop. The post request and response will be appended to the value once they are available.

failureLocation.description: Indicates where in the loop logic did it error out.
enumDescriptions: Setting for loop current element failed.

gaiaIdentity.description: Represents a Gaia identity for a person or service account.

location.description: Required. The location where associated cloud scheduler job will be created

serviceAccountEmail.description: Required. Service account used by Cloud Scheduler to trigger the integration at scheduled time

errorMessage.description: Optional. When the job was deleted from Pantheon UI, error_message will be populated when Get/List integrations

cronTab.description: Required. The cron tab of cloud scheduler trigger.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetStringParam.description: This message only contains a field of string array.

enumDescriptions: OAuth 2.0 Resource Owner Credentials Grant Type.
Service Account which can be used to generate token for authentication.

allowedCredentialTypes.description: Defines the credential types to be supported as Task may restrict specific types to use, e.g. Cloud SQL Task will use username/password type only.

scope.description: A space-delimited list of requested scope permissions.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntParamete.description: This message only contains a field of integer array.

locationName.description: Location name of the key ring, e.g. "us-west1".

keyName.description: A Cloud KMS key is a named object containing one or more key versions, along with metadata for the key. A key exists on exactly one key ring tied to a specific location.

gcpProjectId.description: Optional. The id of GCP project where the KMS key is stored. If not provided, assume the key is stored in the same GCP project defined in Client (tag 14).

keyRingName.description: A key ring organizes keys in a specific Google Cloud location and allows you to manage access control on groups of keys. A key ring's name does not need to be unique across a Google Cloud project, but must be unique within a given location.

keyVersionName.description: Optional. Each version of a key contains key material used for encryption or signing. A key's version is represented by an integer, starting at 1. To decrypt data or verify a signature, you must use the same key version that was used to encrypt or sign the data.

serviceAccount.description: Optional. The service account used for authentication of this KMS key. If this is not provided, the service account in Client.clientSource will be used.

integrationParameters.description: Optional. The list of the new integration parameters.

taskConfig.description: Optional. The task config of the Javascript task.

explanation.description: The explanation of the Javascript code.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetJavascriptR.description: Individual Javascript recommendation containing the task config with the new code, integration parameters and the explanation.

taskId.description: Required. The task id of the Javascript task.

useCurrentScript.description: Optional. Whether to use the current javascript task config (JS code) to generate the Javascript code.

integrationVersion.description: Required. The integration version which contains all the integration parameters, all triggers and tasks including the Javascript task.

copilotEnabled.description: Optional. If this request is for copilot.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetJavascriptR.description: Request message for Javascript Task using Gemini.

integrationParameters.description: Optional. A list of all the workflow parameters of the current integration.

taskConfigs.description: Required. A list of all the tasks of the current integration.

branchCondition.description: Optional. The condition for the particular branch which the user selected.
